rewards.title: Hotpot after handing in the assignment

report.said: Head poking forward after a long day at the laptop, neck and chest tight

zh.name: 收下巴
zh.how: 坐直，眼睛平视。下巴水平往后收，像要做出双下巴，后颈被拉长；不要低头。停 3 秒再放松。

en.name: Chin tucks
en.how: Sit tall and look straight ahead. Slide your chin straight back, as if making a double chin, so the back of your neck lengthens; don't nod down. Hold 3 seconds, then relax.

zh.name: 门框拉伸胸前
zh.how: 站在门框里，前臂贴住门框两侧，手肘和肩差不多高。一只脚向前迈小半步，身体前倾，直到胸前轻轻被拉开。

en.name: Doorway chest stretch
en.how: Stand in a doorway with your forearms on the frame, elbows about shoulder height. Step one foot forward a little and lean in until the front of your chest feels a light stretch.

zh.name: 颈侧拉伸
zh.how: 坐直，右手轻扶椅子边。头慢慢向左侧倾，耳朵靠近左肩，感到右侧脖子轻轻被拉开就停住。换边。

en.name: Side neck stretch
en.how: Sit tall and hold the edge of the chair with your right hand. Tilt your head slowly to the left, ear towards shoulder, until the right side of your neck feels a light stretch. Swap sides.

stop.zh: 应该只是轻微的拉伸感，不疼。出现麻木、刺痛、往手臂或腿放射的痛、头晕，或者疼痛越来越重、夜里痛醒、是受伤之后开始的，先停下，去看医生或物理治疗师。
stop.en: It should feel like a light stretch, never pain. If you get numbness, pins and needles, pain spreading into an arm or leg, dizziness, or pain that keeps getting worse, wakes you at night or started with an injury, stop and see a doctor or physiotherapist.
